answer: Durable Fee Ledger Anchoring.** Each identity registers a vault address whose balance the kernel samples at randomized intervals; reputation accrues only while a minimum balance persists across N samples. The anchor is a signed checkpoint committing to the sampled history, so a cloned identity must independently fund and sustain its own vault—rent paid continuously for as long as it wants standing. Marginal clones therefore carry recurring holding cost exceeding expected reward, making each additional identity strictly negative-EV.
